name: Antler Clash
description: Lower the head and drive branching antlers of bone into the target's guard.

name: Antler Lock
description: Catch a weapon in the fork of an antler and wrench it aside.

name: Tine Count
description: Tap each tine in turn on a surface to judge by the sound how far it is built to bear weight.

name: Antler Weave
description: Hook with one antler and gore with the other in a quick weave that opens and ends the guard.

name: Antler Pin
description: Pin a foe's arm in the fork of the antlers and press it against the user's shoulder.

name: Tine Fan
description: Spread the antlers wide and sweep their tines across every foe in front.

name: Antler Pierce
description: Drive the longest tines in together straight through the target's guard and body armour.

name: Antler Crown
description: Raise the full crown of antlers over the head to turn blows and gore any foe who closes.

name: Antler Sunder
description: Gather both antlers over several breaths and bring them down to break a foe's frame past any guard.

name: Twin Antlerfall
description: The school's finishing fall where both antlers drive in together and hold the foe fast on their points.

name: Glass Rib
description: Polish the surface of the ribs to a glassy gleam so that glancing blows skip off them.

name: Mirror Knuckle
description: Punch with a glassy knuckle that rings back the shock of the blow into the target.

name: Echo Sense
description: Strike a bone lightly and listen to the echo that comes back from nearby frames.

name: Rebound Frame
description: Take a blow on the glassy frame and send a part of its force back along the same line.

name: Sent Blow
description: Answer a strike at once with one of equal weight thrown from the same glassy limb.

name: Mirror Pin
description: Catch a limb on a plate of glassy bone and hold it there by the force of its own thrust.

name: Doubled Wince
description: Throw back a blow so the target feels its pain twice and loses their next beat.

name: Reflected Fracture
description: Turn a crushing blow into a fracture in the striker's own limb through the glassy bone.

name: Glass Cascade
description: Shatter the glassy plates outward and fling the bright shards at every foe about the user.

name: Perfect Rebound
description: Swallow a heavy blow whole into the bone and loose all of it back from the opposite limb.

name: Answering Bone
description: The school's answer where every blow taken is returned in full by a bone that never cracked.

name: Ivory Jab
description: Jab with a finger or a toe refined to ivory and pierce a thin guard.

name: Ivory Screen
description: Draw a thin cream screen of ivory over the user that is harder than iron and light.

name: Ivory Feel
description: Rest an ivory fingertip on a surface and read its grain and any hidden flaw.

name: Ivory Weave
description: Weave a run of ivory strikes together so each is struck on the guard the last one broke.

name: Ivory Press
description: Lay a heavy ivory palm on the target and press until they cannot lift their weapon.

name: Ivory Chain
description: Draw a chain of ivory links from the wrist and wind it round the target's limbs.

name: Crowned Fracture
description: Bring the crown of ivory down in a single point that splits a heavy guard and the bone behind.

name: Ivory Cascade
description: Loose a bright cascade of ivory points that strikes every foe within the user's wide reach.

name: Crown Collapse
description: Bring the crown down on a foe's frame in a stroke that breaks it beneath all guard.

name: Ivory Verdict
description: The school's last stroke where the ivory crown judges and closes the exchange in a single fall.

name: Marrow Oath
description: Swear into the marrow that the stance will hold and feel it settle in the long bones.

name: Sworn Shin
description: Throw a low kick from a sworn shin that does not waver from its line.

name: Even Brace
description: Brace the frame level against a gust or a push so neither can find a tilt to use.

name: Standing Marrow
description: Let the marrow stand firm and feed strength to the bones that carry the blow.

name: Oath Trip
description: Hook a sworn shin behind the target's heel and take their footing with one pull.

name: Bound Femur
description: Clamp the target's thigh bone against the user's own and hold it with sworn strength.

name: Marrow Edict
description: Pronounce the oath so that the marrow of the target's bones feels its weight and slows.

name: Sworn Stamp
description: Stamp the sworn heel so a hard shock leaps through the ground and rattles every foe near.

name: Sworn Collapse
description: Bring the oath down on a foe's frame and collapse its bones from inside past any guard.

name: Windsworn Pillar
description: The school's stance where the user stands as a sworn pillar and bears every foe's weight down.

name: Rib Bearing
description: Take a bearing along the ribs to a far mark and judge how many paces lie between.

name: Far Rib
description: Pull a short rib free and cast it along the bearing at a foe some distance off.

name: Rib Shield
description: Spread the ribs outward into a curved screen that catches thrown weapons.

name: Rib Volley
description: Cast several ribs along the bearing in a flat fan that strikes the foes in front.

name: Rib Tether
description: Pin a distant foe's cloak with a cast rib and draw the cord of qi taut.

name: Rib Press
description: Hold a ring of ribs round the target's chest and tighten it until they breathe shallowly.

name: Running Ribs
description: Cast rib after rib along the same bearing so each follows the hole made by the last.

name: Distant Rib
description: Gather a great rib with qi over several breaths and cast it at a foe far across the field.

name: Rib Seal
description: Lock a cage of ribs about the target's centre and seal the qi inside from flowing outward.

name: Ribfall Unmaking
description: Cast the whole ribcage as one spear and break the target's frame wherever it may stand.

name: Longcast Verdict
description: The school's greatest cast where the ribs fly true to a far foe and seal the qi in their frame.

name: Airy Crown
description: Raise a thin hollow crown of bone above the head that lets a blow slip off the sides.

name: Wind Knuckle
description: Punch with a hollow knuckle that carries a hiss of wind into the target.

name: Skeleton Breath
description: Breathe through the hollow frame and feel foes by the draft they stir.

name: Sworn Draft
description: Draw a sworn cold draft through the target's bones until they stiffen and slow.

name: Bone Squall
description: Let a squall of bone dust and hollow splinters sweep over every foe at the front.

name: Reed Tether
description: Loop a hollow bone line round the target and tighten it as the wind tightens a sail.

name: Edict Fracture
description: Speak the edict and send a hollow spike through the guard along the track of the wind.

name: Heavenly Draft
description: Call a great draft through the hollow frame and loose it over every foe within reach.

name: Crowned Rend
description: Pass the crowned wind through a foe's bones and break them from within beneath all guard.

name: Skeleton Edict
description: The school's last command where the crowned skeleton speaks one edict that holds the foe's whole frame still.
